data.name: HowToT2
data.value: We created downloads.designersguild.com to be a simple, quick and easy resource for our customers to access content to use on their own websites, digital marketing campaigns and print ads. The site has two areas: Advertising Images and Product Images & Feeds. Both are accessible from the menu on the left.

data.name: HowToT4
data.value: We have handpicked a selection of advertising images, representing our entire product range, to assist you with your own advertising campaigns. All are ready for immediate use online or in print.

data.name: HowToT5
data.value: To help you quickly locate a suitable advertising image we have listed all of the options on a single page, simply scroll down, and when you are ready press the [Download for Web] or [Download for Print] button to retrieve the appropriate image. The image will be downloaded by your web browser as quickly as your internet connection allows.

data.value: Using this service, you can download detailed product information and images in a format that is easy to import into your own website.

data.name: HowToT9
data.value: Use the filters on the left to make your product selection. Using the green add to basket buttons you can add individual products to your basket one at a time. Alternatively you may add all your search results in one go using the master add to basket button at the top left of the grid.
